pr.title: Retry failed card payments

issues.title: Temporary card declines fail the payment for good

pr.background: Checkout charges a card once through Stripe, and a webhook reports how it went. A payment moves through a short list of statuses, which the rest of the app reads.
pr.problem: A temporary decline, such as insufficient funds, marks a payment failed for good. The customer has to pay again by hand.
pr.solution: This PR adds [a retry policy](policy) that [the charge flow](charge) asks about each decline, and [a background job](job) that charges again on a schedule. [A new `retrying` status](states) covers everything in between, and [the email and banner](notices) show the retry date. [The tests](tests) cover the job and the attempt limit.

cards.title: Retry policy
cards.summary: Decides whether a declined charge gets another try, and when.
cards.problem: Today every decline is final, including temporary ones such as insufficient funds, so the customer has to pay again by hand.
cards.change: This PR adds [a list of retryable decline codes](payments/retryPolicy.ts#L8) and [a backoff schedule](payments/retryPolicy.ts#L21-L34), and [sets five attempts](config/payments.ts#L5).
cards.fix: A temporary decline now gets more tries before the payment counts as failed.

snippets.why: These lines decide which customers get charged again, and how many times.

lines.text: // Hard declines never succeed on a second try.

cards.title: Charge flow
cards.summary: Takes one payment attempt through Stripe and records the result.
cards.problem: Today a decline marks the payment failed straight away and emails the customer.
cards.change: This PR [routes declines through the policy](payments/charge.ts#L58-L61), and [the webhook now reads `attempts`](api/webhooks/stripe.ts#L44).
cards.fix: A retryable decline moves the payment to `retrying` and queues a job.

snippets.why: Every declined charge in the product now passes through this branch.

cards.title: Retry job
cards.summary: A background job that charges the card again at the scheduled time.
bullets: Runs at the time the policy returned
cards.problem: Today nothing tries a payment again unless the customer does it.
cards.change: This PR adds [the job](jobs/retryPayment.ts#L12-L40) and [registers it](jobs/index.ts#L6).
cards.fix: Retries run without the customer doing anything.

snippets.why: This calls the same charge path again, so anything it does runs once per attempt.

cards.title: Payment states
cards.summary: The list of statuses a payment can be in, stored on each payment row.
cards.problem: Today a payment is pending, paid or failed, so nothing can say it will be tried again.
cards.fix: The rest of the app can tell a payment in progress from one that is finished.

snippets.why: Code anywhere that switches on status now meets a value it has never seen.

reaches.effect: It [counts `failed` payments as lost revenue](reports/revenue.ts#L31), so a `retrying` payment drops out of that total.
It [shows the write-off action only for `failed`](admin/RefundPanel.tsx#L52), so that stays hidden while a payment is retrying.
It [posts on every `failed` event](alerts/slack.ts#L18), so the alert now fires after the last attempt.

unaffected.reason: They show the status as text and make no decision on it.

cards.title: Customer notices
cards.summary: The email and billing banner that tell a customer a payment had a problem.
cards.change: This PR [shows a retry date](ui/billing/PaymentBanner.tsx#L24) in place of the old failure message, because the payment is no longer failed.
cards.fix: Customers see that a retry is coming, and when.

snippets.why: This renders only while the status is retrying.

cards.title: Retry tests
cards.summary: Tests for the schedule, the attempt limit and the final failure.
bullets: Run the job against a fake Stripe client
cards.change: This PR adds [402 lines of tests](tests/payments/retry.test.ts#L1-L402) for the job and the policy.

snippets.why: This is the only assertion on the attempt limit.

edges.label: Decides each retry
edges.connection: `charge()` asks the policy what to do with each decline.
edges.flow: A change to [the retryable codes](payments/retryPolicy.ts#L8) changes what every charge does on a decline.

edges.label: Queues the job
edges.connection: `schedule()` adds a `retryPayment` job for the time the policy returned.
edges.flow: The job then [calls `charge()` again](jobs/retryPayment.ts#L23), so the two run in a loop until the policy returns nothing.

edges.label: Adds retrying
edges.connection: `charge()` writes the new status on the payment.
edges.flow: A declined payment now [sits in `retrying`](payments/states.ts#L4) where it used to be `failed`.

edges.label: Drives the banner
edges.connection: The banner picks its message from the status.
edges.flow: [The new status](payments/states.ts#L4) is what makes the retry notice appear.

edges.label: Tests the limit
edges.connection: The tests drive `charge()` against a fake Stripe client.
edges.flow: They [run a declined charge through to the end](tests/payments/retry.test.ts#L118-L119) and assert the attempt limit.
